name: Advait Energy Transitions Limited
about: Advait Energy Transitions Limited (formerly known as, Advait Infratech Limited)  established in 2009 and headquartered in Gujarat, is a global leader in end-to-end solutions for power transmission, substations, and telecommunication infrastructure.Advait's core capabilities include the manufacturing and supply of Stringing Tools, ACS Wires, OPGW Cables, ERS, Optical Fibre Cables, and a comprehensive range of insulators. The company has delivered complex EPC projects, including live-line OPGW installations, underground cabling, and integration of MVCC and HT AB cables, demonstrating its end-to-end project execution capabilities.In 2023, Advait expanded into the renewable energy domain, undertaking projects in Green Hydrogen and Solar Power integration.

return_mathematics.pathway_rationale: Significant CWIP (₹160 Cr, 148.1% of Fixed Assets) transitioning to commercialization over FY26–FY28 unlocks operating leverage.

guidance_tracker.fy27_target_outlook: 20-25%+ volume growth supported by capacity monetization

invalidation_triggers: Exit if Operating Profit Margin (OPM) drops by > 300 bps for two consecutive quarters without raw material inflation relief.
Exit if 3Y cumulative CFO/PAT drops below 0.55x (indicates aggressive revenue recognition or stuck inventory).
Exit if Debt-to-Equity rises above 0.75x or Promoter Pledge increases above 5.0%.
Exit if management delays stated Capex / capacity commercialization timeline by > 3 quarters.
